caption: The drawing depicts a single high-backed armchair with winged sides, rolled arms, and an upholstered seat and back. The upholstery features a densely patterned floral design in shades of red, blue, and green on a beige background. The flowers and leaves are arranged in a repeating order and cover all visible fabric surfaces of the chair, including the arms, wings, seat, and back. The chair’s frame and legs are made of wood with a dark brown finish; the legs in the front are cabriole in form, while the back legs are straight. There are turned wooden stretcher bars connecting the legs for additional support, some featuring rounded decorative elements. The background of the drawing is light beige and plain, with no additional objects or patterns present.
title: Wing Chair
